description.zh: 任务流ID，任务流的唯一标识。可通过调用[ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~)或[ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The unique ID of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to query the task flow ID.

description.zh: 任务流运行失败通知开关。默认关闭，请手动开启。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable notifications for failed task flows. Notifications are disabled by default. You can enable notifications based on your business requirements.

description.zh: 任务流SLA通知全局开关。默认关闭，请手动开启。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable SLA global notifications for task flows. Notifications are disabled by default. You can enable notifications based on your business requirements.

description.zh: 任务流运行成功通知开关。默认关闭，请手动开启。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable notifications for successful task flows. Notifications are disabled by default. You can enable notifications based on your business requirements.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise update-task-flow-notification --tid 3000 --dag-id 15000 --dag-notification-fail true --dag-notification-success true --dag-notification-sla true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise UpdateTaskFlowNotification --region cn-hangzhou --DagNotificationSuccess true --DagNotificationSla true --Tid 3000 --DagId 15000 --DagNotificationFail true
